verdict.rationale: Workspace documents automatic user provisioning for third-party apps such as Office 365, where changes to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to the downstream app (docs-13, docs-26). The Cloud Identity API is described as a provisioning API for identity resources (docs-7), but the evidence covers user sync for specific catalog apps only. missing for 10: explicit SCIM protocol support, pushing groups and entitlements downstream, evidence that provisioning fires immediately on access assignment, broad custom-app coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
